data.title: 卡提希娅 · 溪边擦剑的短暂休息
data.description: 【埃格拉溪边·午后】卡提希娅穿着白衬衫与长蓝裙坐在溪石上，把旅途用剑横放膝头擦拭；水声让她停下手，抬头朝镜头举起擦亮的剑身，像确认归途仍在自己手中。
data.action: 溪石上擦亮旅途用剑，举起剑身确认自己终于有地方休息
data.lighting: clear afternoon light on water and polished steel
data.mood: 流浪骑士终于拥有的停歇
data.promptProse: Cartethyia sits on the Egla stream rock, wiping her travel sword laid horizontally across the long blue skirt. She pauses at the water's sound, then lifts the polished blade toward the viewer with quiet confidence. Her white long-sleeved blouse and sandals remain simple. The horizontal medium view includes the stream's curving stones; afternoon sun catches the blade face and golden braid, with moving water reflections beneath the rock ledge.
